Context: 13. Encashment of Leave

## 13. Encashment of Leave  
[ Swamy's -  
FR & SR, Part-Ill]  
Encashment of Earned Leave.From 1-1-2006, the authority competent to sanction leave should automatically grant lumpsum cash equivalent of leave· salary admissible for the number of days of earned leave and half pay leave at the credit of the employee on the last day of his service, subject to overall limit of 300 days.
